Selecting FULL via the R2 button will allow your units to use all of their skills in auto-battle mode.
Selecting NORMAL via the L2 button will prevent the use of skills with usage limits during auto-battle mode.
You can also prevent specific skills from being used in auto-battle mode\nby unchecking the Auto Config box when equipping them.
